_task_description: No-reset lifelong cross-room task. First, in the private office, take the clean dry spare lint screen from the desk and stage it on the washer beside the dryer. Then go to the corridor, take the dirty lint screen, return to the utility-room sink, wash it, and stage the now clean wet screen on the washer. Take out the dirty lint screen from the dryer. Finally, with three visually similar lint screens staged on the washer, install the clean dry screen in the dryer, wash the dirty screen, and return the newly washed wet screen to the private-office desk.
